title: On Inspiring the boys with one short story
subtitle: 努力坚持 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 努力坚持（人与自我·做人与做事·努力与坚持）
meta: 主题语境：努力坚持（人与自我·做人与做事·努力与坚持）　|　核心词汇：inspire　|　正文 357 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 inspire 的形式与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1990 the craftsman ① inspired the boys with one short story in the rain, and every apprentice in the workshop said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three years on, people still spoke of how quietly it was done and of how, ever since, the craftsman ② inspires the boys with one short story without complaint without being asked. My mother said later that to ③ inspire the boys with one short story at all was the part nobody had expected.

By then somebody had surely ④ inspired the boys with one short story before — a line in the ledger for August 1984 hints at it — but nobody could name the person. ⑤ Inspiring the boys with one short story in the rain, the craftsman said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve; it is not the doing of it that people remember.

My uncle, who kept the tool at the far bench, meant the other thing entirely. He said that if anybody should ever ⑥ inspire the design of the whole picture without complaint, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again. The rule the old hands handed down was plainer still: ⑦ Inspire the design of the whole picture at once and never mention it again.

By 1997 the whole business had shrunk to half a line in the ledger, and a new apprentice from the next workshop ⑧ inspires the design of the whole picture in the rain every year without once asking what it had cost the first time. My mother, who had watched all of it from the bench, said nothing at all; she simply ⑨ inspired the boys with one short story again when nobody else would.

⑩ To inspire the boys with one short story, my mother said in 2002, is not one thing but two: what you do and what the workshop remembers of it. She said the second half never grows lighter, and nowadays, whenever the workshop forgets, somebody inspires the boys with one short story without complaint again and somebody must inspire the boys with one short story in the rain all over again.

task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. v. 激励（一般过去式 inspired the boys with one short story：1990 年匠人头一回这样做，淋着雨）
B. v. 激励（一般现在 inspires the boys with one short story：自那以后成了老习惯，不必有人开口）
C. v. 激励（不定式 to inspire the boys with one short story：文中两处，一是母亲说的“难就难在……”，一是结尾那句格言）
D. v. 激励（过去完成时 had inspired the boys with one short story：1984 年八月的工料簿上那行字之前就有人做过）
E. v. 激励（动名词 inspiring the boys with one short story 作主语：“九分耐心、一分胆气”那一句）
F. v. 启发（inspire the design of the whole picture：should ever 之后的原形，指万一真要去启发启发了整幅画的构思）
G. v. 启发（inspire the design of the whole picture：祈使句，转述老手们当年立下的那条规矩）
H. v. 激励（后段两处：新来的学徒照例 inspires the design of the whole picture，而母亲又一次 inspired the boys with one short story）

inspire 意为“激励”，结尾那句是母亲 2002 年的话：要激励一个短故事把孩子们激励起来，其实不是一件事，而是两件事——你做的那一件，和工坊记住的那一件。

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 inspire 的 3 种不同形式（过去式、第三人称、-ing、不定式等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1990 the craftsman inspired the boys with one short story in the rain, and nobody in the workshop forgot it.
Even now the craftsman inspires the boys with one short story without complaint whenever the workshop asks.
Inspiring the boys with one short story in the rain, my mother used to say, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
If anybody should ever inspire the design of the whole picture without complaint, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again.
A new apprentice from the next workshop inspires the design of the whole picture in the rain every year, asking nothing about the past.
When nobody else would, my mother inspired the boys with one short story again, and the workshop remembered that half.
